import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': [np.nan, 'C', np.nan, 'C', np.nan],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by passenger class and sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_data = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.legend(title='Sex')
ax1.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Third'], rotation=0)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
for survived_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['survived'] == survived_status]
    color = 'red' if survived_status == 0 else 'green'
    label = 'Died' if survived_status == 0 else 'Survived'
    ax2.hist(subset['age'], alpha=0.5, color=color, label=label, bins=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Fare distribution by passenger class
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
df.boxplot(column='fare', by='pclass', ax=ax3, grid=False)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax3.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Third'])

# 4. Survival by embarkation port
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].mean()
colors = ['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral']
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=colors[:len(embark_survival)])
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Cherbourg', 'Southampton'], rotation=0)

# 5. Family size vs survival
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
family_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color='teal')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numerical_cols = ['survived', 'pclass', 'age', 'sibsp', 'parch', 'fare']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=ax6, 
            square=True, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
